value.rationale: Beyond the initiating existence theorem's single explicit non-torsion section, identifies an entire rank-four geometric family of genus-g (-1) curves and a uniform 24-curve intersection geometry (24-cell distance shell), with exact determinant and rank lower bound. This motivates the exact invariant for every genus and gives concrete geometric organization of negative curves on recently constructed surfaces, without claiming a full Mordell--Weil census.
